description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart comparing the accuracy of different models across three tasks: paraphrase sentiment, sentiment-to-sentence (STS), and humor detection. The horizontal axis displays the model names—Star Alliance, BERT, and RoBERTa—listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Three bars are present for each model, representing its accuracy on each of the three tasks, and are colored blue for paraphrase sentiment, orange for STS, and green for humor detection. For Star Alliance, the bars reach approximately 22.2 for paraphrase sentiment, 36.1 for STS, and 34.4 for humor detection. BERT’s bars reach approximately 44.4 for paraphrase sentiment, 53.3 for STS, and 51.1 for humor detection. Finally, RoBERTa’s bars reach approximately 51.1 for paraphrase sentiment, 58.9 for STS, and 54.4 for humor detection. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing one bar for each task, arranged adjacent to each other. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
